children: SS Innovations reported milestone growth with 238 SSi Mantra installations and 14,103 cumulative procedures.
Global installed base reached 238 systems as of Sept 8, 2026, up 42% from 168 at end of 2025.
SSi Mantra procedures totaled 14,103 as of Sept 8, 2026, a 79% increase from 7,885 at end of 2025.
Company expanded into Sri Lanka and Colombia; first robotic cardiac surgery in Colombia and first system installed in Sri Lanka.
Pediatric use: 258 pediatric robotic surgeries completed with SSi Mantra as of Aug 31, 2026, including a 45-day-old infant pyeloplasty.
Telesurgery milestones: 188 cumulative telesurgeries and a record >13,600-mile Colombia–India telesurgery; telesurgery launched in the Philippines.
